attribution_boundaries.origin: Miller, Galanter, Pribram, Plans and the Structure of Behavior (1960); attribution supported here by later Dilts text, no original-page claim. Preserve original source misspelling Gallanter inside quotes.
attribution_boundaries.bandler_grinder: Only congruency/output channels have a book-page locator, and it is a SECONDARY quotation of Vol. II p.45, not a page independently read. No exact early-book TOTE usage verified.
attribution_boundaries.later_dilts: Terms and functional statements are attributed to accessible Dilts webpages or their explicitly identified quotations; no transfer to 1975/1976 books.
attribution_boundaries.nlp_volume_i_1980: Dilts biography lists collaboration with Grinder, Bandler and DeLozier; book not accessed. This page is not a title-page check or a guaranteed exhaustive author list. No exact terms/locators taken from it.
attribution_boundaries.date_conflicts: Tools for Dreamers quoted as 1993 on source 1 but listed as 1991 on source 6. Vol.II quoted as 1976 on source 1 while Google catalog displays 1975. These are unresolved bibliographic/edition distinctions, not silently corrected.
